query_analysis.original_query: What is the most effective way to prevent weeping in sieve trays used in crude oil fractionation towers?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and recommend the most effective methods or design modifications to prevent liquid weeping through sieve tray perforations in crude oil fractionation columns.

clarification_questions: What are the current operating conditions (temperature, pressure) of the fractionation tower?
What is the composition and flow rate of the crude oil feed?
What are the current sieve tray specifications (hole size, pitch, thickness)?
